name: Clarks Fork of the Yellowstone
blurb: South-central Montana's other Clarks Fork — Bridger and Fromberg water, not the Idaho canyon.

sections.notes: Irrigation diversions require current local guidance. Unconfirmed town and bridge exits are not recommended as alternatives.
